subject: Re: Project Sirocco kickoff — staffing + compute
body:
Dmitri,

Sirocco resourcing:

Staffing — Efe 50% as TL, Halima 40% on the ink-parsing/loader code, Tereza 50% on the reference recognizer, Yara 25% on the Evalline metric integration. Stable through end of June.

Compute — training the reference recognizer is modest: 16 A100s on titan best-effort for ~10 days covers the sweep. No vulcan reservation needed. Storage for the 2.9 GB archive plus derived tensors goes on Corpus; intake filed yesterday.

Dependency — the Corpus team is mid-v2-migration, so I asked Jun's team to confirm our new bucket won't be touched by the freeze; we should have everything ingested by late April anyway, well clear of the 2026-07-10 freeze date.

One ask: can you get the Kofi license conversation moving this week? Tereza doesn't want to train on data we later have to quarantine.

Alina
